limitations: Required checks use Apache Jena RDFS inference, not a complete OWL DL reasoner.
OWL imports, restrictions, lists, equivalence, inverse, transitivity and disjointness are unsupported in ontology/data graphs.
Domain and range infer types; required values are checked with SHACL.
A false ASK result means not entailed under this profile, not proof of negation.
SPARQL is limited to local ASK/SELECT graph patterns and safe comparison filters; extension functions, paths, aggregates, SERVICE and dataset loading are blocked.
SHACL uses the asserted graph plus RDFS closure and a restricted SHACL Core vocabulary.
